vocabulary.meaning: 严肃的，严重的，认真的，危险的

examples.text: You have no business entering that office building after dark.
examples.translation: 天黑后，你无权进入那栋办公楼。
examples.speechText: You have no business entering that office building after dark.

examples.text: Patience also gives you strength and courage to face any situation.
examples.translation: 耐心还会给你力量和勇气，让你面对任何情况。
examples.speechText: Patience also gives you strength and courage to face any situation.

examples.text: Chloe, aged（age的过去分词形式） 15, even sleeps with her phone.
examples.translation: 十五岁的Chloe甚至连睡觉都带着手机。
examples.speechText: Chloe, aged 15, even sleeps with her phone.

examples.text: As all serious rock, paper, scissors players know, there’s more to the game than luck.
examples.translation: 正如所有认真对待石头、剪刀、布游戏的玩家都知道的那样，这个游戏不仅仅取决于运气。
examples.speechText: As all serious rock, paper, scissors players know, there’s more to the game than luck.

examples.text: She tries her best to keep up with the changes in fashion.
examples.translation: 她尽最大努力跟上时尚的变化。
examples.speechText: She tries her best to keep up with the changes in fashion.

examples.text: Although quitting（quit的-ing形式） drinking can be difficult, you will never be sorry if you make this decision.
examples.translation: 虽然戒酒可能很难，但只要作出这个决定，你绝不会后悔。
examples.speechText: Although quitting drinking can be difficult, you will never be sorry if you make this decision.

examples.text: But surprisingly, some of the driest（dry的最高级） places on Earth lie right beside the ocean.
examples.translation: 但令人惊讶的是，地球上一些最干旱的地方就位于海洋旁边。
examples.speechText: But surprisingly, some of the driest places on Earth lie right beside the ocean.

examples.text: I had dreamed about it for years（year的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 多年来，我一直梦想着这件事。
examples.speechText: I had dreamed about it for years.

examples.text: Nowadays, we still have a collecting（collect的-ing形式） instinct.
examples.translation: 如今，我们仍然保留着收藏的本能。
examples.speechText: Nowadays, we still have a collecting instinct.

examples.text: His wife had a great influence on Twain's later books.
examples.translation: 他的妻子对吐温后来的作品产生了很大影响。
examples.speechText: His wife had a great influence on Twain's later books.

examples.text: Many people think the game is all luck.
examples.translation: 许多人认为，这个游戏全靠运气。
examples.speechText: Many people think the game is all luck.

examples.text: Its popularity in the United States continues to grow.
examples.translation: 它在美国的受欢迎程度继续增长。
examples.speechText: Its popularity in the United States continues to grow.

examples.text: Convenience foods（food的复数形式） from the supermarket simplify shopping and cooking.
examples.translation: 超市里的方便食品让购物和做饭变得更简单。
examples.speechText: Convenience foods from the supermarket simplify shopping and cooking.

examples.text: It is time for students to go back to school.
examples.translation: 到了学生们回学校的时候了。
examples.speechText: It is time for students to go back to school.

examples.text: The only thing now standing in the way of further progress is lack of money.
examples.translation: 目前唯一阻碍进一步进展的是资金不足。
examples.speechText: The only thing now standing in the way of further progress is lack of money.
